title: Meaning that can travel
governing_claim: Knowledge becomes reusable when meaning, subject, provenance and scope stay attached and a tested consumption route exists.
reader_success: Explain why source meaning, subject, version and provenance must remain connected.
Distinguish structured, applicable and executable knowledge.
Explain what a method or skill adds beyond document storage.
Identify what must be reviewed before the same knowledge informs another task.

steps.claim: Start with the meaning and its source scope.
steps.salient: The source proposition remains readable and linked to the task it informs.
steps.hold_fixed: No structured field or extracted value silently replaces the source meaning.
steps.false_inference_risk: A highlighted passage can look authoritative for every subject or scenario.

steps.claim: Structuring adds explicit context; it does not add authority.
steps.salient: Subject, field meaning, version and provenance become explicit while the source remains attached.
steps.hold_fixed: Structured is not automatically applicable or approved.
steps.false_inference_risk: A neat record can imply the ambiguity is resolved when current aliases or lookups remain unknown.

steps.claim: Structured, applicable and executable are different states.
steps.salient: The consumption boundary is visible between stored meaning and a tested way to use it in work.
steps.hold_fixed: Document presence, runtime availability and permitted consumption remain separate.
steps.false_inference_risk: Layering can imply maturity progression rather than different conditions.

steps.claim: A method binds selected context to a bounded task.
steps.salient: Inputs, steps, output, failure modes and review are part of the execution contract.
steps.hold_fixed: The method is a synthetic bounded preparation example, not a deployed shared skill.
steps.false_inference_risk: A reusable method may be mistaken for a production service or autonomous agent.

steps.claim: Not all available knowledge belongs in every task.
steps.salient: A review aperture makes purpose, applicability and permitted use visible before context enters the task packet.
steps.hold_fixed: Selection is qualitative; visual width does not encode amount, quality or approval.
steps.false_inference_risk: A funnel shape may imply automatic scoring or ranking.

steps.salient: The next task needs its own applicability, ownership, source/version, maintenance and consumption review.
steps.hold_fixed: A good result in one task is not automatically institutional knowledge for another.
steps.false_inference_risk: A reuse arrow can imply an automatic feedback loop.
